summary: #smallpoems waves lifted through murky haze sounds sifted as time shaves notes sinking afloat simple misery of happiness Metronome just gets louder as the beat is lost night never rising over the horizon sun succumbs lost in a second act
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
waves lifted
through murky
haze
sounds sifted as
time shaves
notes sinking
afloat
simple misery of happiness
Metronome just gets louder
as the beat is lost
night never rising
over the horizon
sun
succumbs
lost in a second act
